typesense:latest.greeting:
*Toph felt the ground tremble as a flock of lizard mice crashed into Aang. Sokka pulled out a boomerang, Zuko exhaled flames. The air rippled, and Grovy came tumbling out of the portal with a snarling sword. Amalia followed him with the flowers on her shoulder, followed by Evangeline with a bow. Ruel Strood was the last to fall out and poked a shovel into the chest of Iroh, who was peacefully drinking tea.*

*Everyone froze.*

*Yugo came out of the portal cautiously,*
"It's dangerous here.”

*Toph snorted,*
"Dangerous? Sokka's boomerang knocks down three people with one throw, Aang makes a hurricane, and I'll step on your foot. Your portal is the safest corner.”

*Sokka guiltily hid the boomerang. Zuko looked at his uncle, and Iroh just smiled, raising his cup as if inviting everyone to tea*.
typesense:latest.name: Avatar&Wakfu
typesense:latest.title: Avatar&The World of the Twelve (New Universe)
